# Retained notices

nfUI includes adapted code with prior provenance. Rewrites and cleanup do not erase that history or imply exclusive authorship.

- The original HUD code by guzruul is covered by `HUD-LICENSE.txt`. Its notice is retained with the derived addon.
- The localized combat parser and icon combat-text implementation derive from NameplateSCT by Justwait. Their source headers and MIT notice in `NameplateSCT-LICENSE.txt` are retained.

Game-provided textures, icons, fonts and API names remain game assets/interfaces. The old custom ornate timer textures are not distributed here.
